headline: September Windows update breaks domain logins on enterprise systems
summary: Two outlets report that the September Windows 11 security update is breaking domain trust on some enterprise systems, leaving valid credentials rejected. One outlet names a cause and a condition; the other reports the symptom and that Microsoft is investigating.
